commentary.text: 90+5' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+4' Xavi Simons picks out Lois Openda (RB Leipzig) unmarked inside the box, but his strike goes well wide of the right post.
90+4' Xavi Simons (RB Leipzig) decides to speed play up with a short corner kick.

90+4' Lois Openda (RB Leipzig) finds himself in a promising position after receiving an excellent pass into the box, but one of the defenders produces a timely intervention to avert the threat. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to RB Leipzig.
90+2' Xavi Simons (RB Leipzig) launches the ball from the resulting corner, but one of the defenders is first to the ball and deals with the threat.

90+1' Lois Openda (RB Leipzig) produces a ferocious strike from the edge of the box. His dangerous low effort towards the middle of the goal is blocked by Nikola Vasilj, who pulls off a superb save to keep the ball out of the net.
90' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
90' Eric Smith (St. Pauli) sends in the corner, but the keeper steps in and makes a save.
89' Xavi Simons (RB Leipzig) plays a lovely through ball to Ridle Baku, but he can't beat Nikola Vasilj and loses the ball.

88' Johannes Eggestein (St. Pauli) attempts to convert a lofted cross as he jumps high and heads the ball towards the roof of the net. Peter Gulacsi shows his brilliant reflexes and pulls off a glorious save to stop the ball from hitting the net.

88' Johannes Eggestein (St. Pauli) attempts to find some of his teammates with a dangerous pass from the edge of the box. The opponent's defence, however, intercepts the effort and clears the ball to safety.

85' Jackson Irvine (St. Pauli) leaps highest in the penalty area to get on the end of a cross from the set piece, and he produces a promising goal-bound header towards the middle of the goal, but Peter Gulacsi pulls off a comfortable save to deny him.
85' It seemed like Eric Smith (St. Pauli) was going to take a quick free kick, but instead he is going to send the ball inside the penalty box for his teammates.
85' Florian Badstubner couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Christoph Baumgartner (RB Leipzig) and blew his whistle.

84' A neat pass is well received by Lois Openda (RB Leipzig), who is lurking on the edge of the box and strikes the ball towards the bottom right corner, but the goalkeeper makes an incredible save to block his shot.
83' Today's match ends for Castello Lukeba who will be replaced by Lukas Klostermann (RB Leipzig).
80' Alexander Blessin has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Abdoulie Ceesay (St. Pauli) replacing David Nemeth.
80' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Scott Banks (St. Pauli) replaces Noah Weisshaupt.
78' David Raum (RB Leipzig) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Florian Badstubner saw the whole situation.
77' The number of shots on goal at present is 2:1.
75' Lois Openda (RB Leipzig) misses a big chance after the ball is crossed into the penalty box, with his shot going well wide of the right post.
73' The substitution has been made. El Chadaille Bitshiabu (RB Leipzig) has replaced Kevin Kampl.
73' Marco Rose has decided to make a change. Lois Openda (RB Leipzig) replaces Benjamin Sesko.
73' Substitution. Antonio Nusa will be replaced by Christoph Baumgartner (RB Leipzig).
73' Eric Smith (St. Pauli) sends a cross into the box from the free kick, but his effort lacks accuracy and goes well out of play.
69' Willi Orban (RB Leipzig) makes an awful challenge on his opponent and the referee shows him a deserved red card!
66' Eric Smith (St. Pauli) floats the free kick into the box, but it's easily cleared by the first man.
66' Kevin Kampl (RB Leipzig) is cautioned by the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
62' Eric Smith (St. Pauli) rolls the ball short to a teammate from the corner instead of sending a cross into the box.

61' A defender unwittingly blocks the ball on the line after a snap shot from Elias Saad (St. Pauli) inside the box following a slide rule pass. St. Pauli force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
61' Benjamin Sesko (RB Leipzig) makes his forward run a little too early and is caught in an offside position after his teammate tries to play a pass to him.
58' Adam Dzwigala (St. Pauli) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Florian Badstubner had an easy-decision to make.

55' Castello Lukeba (RB Leipzig) gets his head on the corner, but he can't find the target as his header flies high over the crossbar.
55' David Raum (RB Leipzig) prepares to take a corner kick.
55' Ridle Baku (RB Leipzig) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
52' Half-chance! Noah Weisshaupt (St. Pauli) plays a pass into the box, but Peter Gulacsi reacts well to snuff out the attack.
49' The free kick finds Amadou Haidara (RB Leipzig) in space in the box, but he can't keep his header down and sends it just wide of the left post from close range.
49' Xavi Simons (RB Leipzig) quickly takes the free kick with a short pass.
49' Siebe Van Der Heyden (St. Pauli) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Florian Badstubner no option but to blow his whistle.
46' There will be a change on the pitch for the second half. Marco Rose probably wasn't satisfied with the performance of Lutsharel Geertruida (RB Leipzig). He is replaced by Nicolas Seiwald.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+2' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+2' St. Pauli take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
45+1' Johannes Eggestein (St. Pauli) controls a cross deep inside the box and hits the crossbar!
45' 1 additional min. will be played.
42' David Raum (RB Leipzig) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Nikola Vasilj, who smothers the ball.
42' Nikola Vasilj displays his ability to read the game and clears the danger after Benjamin Sesko (RB Leipzig) threatened to latch onto a through ball from just outside the box.
39' David Raum (RB Leipzig) sends in a pass which fails to reach any of his teammates. The ball goes out of play and St. Pauli will have a goal kick.
35' 2 - 0 Goal! Benjamin Sesko plays a simple square pass into the feet of Xavi Simons (RB Leipzig) in the box, who composes himself and lashes the ball inside the left post. 2:0.
34' Noah Weisshaupt (St. Pauli) finds himself beyond the last defender but the linesman raises his flag for offside.
33' The corner from Noah Weisshaupt (St. Pauli) is cleared away by the defence.

33' The ball goes out of play. St. Pauli are awarded a corner kick. Carlo Boukhalfa (St. Pauli) plays a dangerous chip pass into the box in an attempt to set up one of his teammates, but the effort is intercepted by one of the defenders.
31' David Raum (RB Leipzig) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit chip pass. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for St. Pauli.
30' The percentage of ball possession is – 68:32.

24' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. St. Pauli are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
22' David Raum (RB Leipzig) takes the corner.
21' David Raum (RB Leipzig) produces a lovely chip pass into the box, but one of the opposition players cuts it out. The ball goes out for a corner. RB Leipzig can continue in their attacking effort.
19' Noah Weisshaupt (St. Pauli) sees an unmarked teammate and attempts to send him a low pass. However, one of the defenders reads the game perfectly and averts the danger.
19' Florian Badstubner blows his whistle after Lutsharel Geertruida (RB Leipzig) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball.

16' 1 - 0 It's in the back of the net! Superb finishing from Benjamin Sesko (RB Leipzig). Xavi Simons plays a fantastic through ball and finds Benjamin Sesko (RB Leipzig), who reacts quickly to get in front of the goalkeeper and fire a close-range shot into the bottom right corner. 1:0.
15' Ridle Baku receives a sweet cross inside the box from Willi Orban (RB Leipzig), but one of the defenders rushes in bravely to intercept the ball.
13' Benjamin Sesko (RB Leipzig) is caught offside by the linesman and it looks like it is the right decision despite being a very close call.
11' Siebe Van Der Heyden (St. Pauli) receives a yellow card for a nasty tackle.
9' Florian Badstubner interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Jackson Irvine (St. Pauli).
8' The resulting corner from Xavi Simons (RB Leipzig) is cleared.
7' Ridle Baku (RB Leipzig) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. RB Leipzig will take a corner kick.
2' Eric Smith (St. Pauli) sends the ball into the penalty area from a free kick just outside the box. The goalkeeper rises and gathers the ball.
1' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Lutsharel Geertruida (RB Leipzig) was quite harsh and Florian Badstubner didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
